Netflix documentary explores influencer's rise and fall

A Netflix documentary titled 'Raygun' examines the career of an internet influencer, detailing her rise to fame and subsequent personal struggles. The film illustrates how she "broke the internet" and ultimately "herself" through her online presence and activities. The documentary focuses on the impact of her digital footprint and the personal cost of her online persona.
